text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. Entry rights are 
granted to the Umamusume who rank at the 
top of the fan vote."

Mejiro Ryan earned a spot in the race 
thanks to her recognized performance in 
the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! You're running in the Arima Kinen 
too, right!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —I will... pass, if you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I pushed myself too hard in the lead-up to 
the Kikuka Sho. I shall take every 
precaution to be in peak condition for 
next year's main event.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, farewell. Do enjoy the banquet 
of monsters.

—A feast of monsters. Senior-class 
Umamusume will also be running in the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that... the legendary monster, Oguri 
Cap-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The super superstar Umamusume that 
everyone knows...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
S-So popular... But more than anything, 
her aura is incredible...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Trainer, I think I might have 
ended up somewhere incredible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, McQueen and the Classics 
were everything to me. But out here, 
there's such a vast world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Twinkle Series... This is 
the Arima Kinen...
choice_data_list: Feel like you can give it your all?
Feel like you can give it your all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-Of course! I won't let myself lose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it's truly terrifying... 
Oguri-san... No, the depths of everyone 
besides Oguri-san are bottomless too..."
